attributes.board_name: Nebraska Board of Pharmacy (DHHS Licensure Unit)

rules.alternatives: Technicians must complete a Board-approved state or national pharmacy technician certification program (within one year of registration for those registered after January 1, 2016).
rules.notes: Registration renews every two years (January 1 of odd-numbered years) without a CE requirement: DHHS's registration, renewal and reinstatement information lists certification, the fee and the reinstatement documents, but no continuing education.
rules.rule_quote: Registrations are renewable January 1 of odd-numbered years.
